A used car with a plan is a different listing than one without.

Twenty months is when a lot of people start thinking about the next car. If the {{{VEHICLE}}} is headed to a listing, know this: the plan can transfer to the buyer. Remaining coverage, same terms, same claims line.
A buyer looking at two similar cars picks the one that comes with a service contract. You can say so in the listing. Call Ascent before the sale to handle the transfer paperwork, and settle the Budco balance so it transfers clean.

TO TRANSFER
1: Call Ascent, 866-660-7003, before the sale
2: Settle the Budco balance, 888-352-7901
3: Give the buyer the contract number and the two phone numbers
4: Put it in the listing. It is a feature.

If you are not selling, file this under good to know. If you are, it is worth real money in the listing and real calm for whoever buys it.

Ask Ascent about a transfer -> tel:18666607003
Transfer rules and any fee vary by state. Ascent will tell you exactly.

A listing that says comes with a transferable service contract gets fewer tire kickers. That is a technical term.

Stuck on the payment step? Budco Financial Services: 888-352-7901. Coverage or claims: Ascent, 866-660-7003.
